nodes.title: First-Year Chinese for Dialect Speakers I
nodes.prereq_text: placement interview required for department approval to enroll.
nodes.description: Introductory Mandarin Chinese language course intended for students with some proficiency in a Chinese dialect other than Mandarin. Part one of a three-quarter sequence covering fundamentals of pronunciation, Chinese grammar, and vocabulary through interactive classes.

nodes.title: First-Year Chinese for Mandarin Speakers I
nodes.prereq_text: placement interview required for department approval to enroll.
nodes.description: Introductory Mandarin Chinese language course intended for students with some oral proficiency but who have not had formal written training in Mandarin. Part one of a three-quarter sequence focusing on increasing literacy with basic characters and covering fundamentals of Chinese grammar, pronunciation, and vocabulary through interactive classes.

nodes.title: Late Imperial and Twentieth-Century Chinese Historical Texts
nodes.prereq_text: advanced knowledge of Chinese language and consent of instructor.
nodes.description: This course introduces the primary sources used by historians of late Imperial and twentieth-century Chinese history. Reading material includes diaries, newspaper articles, Qing documents, gazetteers, essays, speeches, popular fiction, journal articles, scholarly prose, and field surveys. May be repeated for credit. (P/NP grades only.)

nodes.title: Business Chinese I
nodes.prereq_text: any one of the following or department approval through placement interview: CHIN 100CM, CHIN 100CN, CHIN 165B-C, CHIN 185A-B-C.
nodes.description: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course that focuses on oral and written communication skills for business, including introduction to modern business terminology and social conventions.

nodes.title: Business Chinese II

nodes.title: Business Chinese III

nodes.title: Medical Chinese I
nodes.prereq_text: any one of the following or department approval through placement interview: CHIN 165A-B-C, CHIN 169B, CHIN 182A-B-C.
nodes.description: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course that focuses on conversational medical Chinese for students interested in medicine and health care. Designed to prepare students to speak, listen, and read effectively in a Chinese medical environment and build necessary medical vocabulary.

nodes.title: Medical Chinese II
nodes.prereq_text: any one of the following or department approval through placement interview: CHIN 165A-B-C, CHIN 169A, CHIN 182A-B-C.

Designed to prepare students to speak, listen, and read effectively in a Chinese medical environment and build necessary medical vocabulary.

nodes.title: Classical Chinese I
nodes.prereq_text: any one of the following or department approval through placement interview: CHIN 165A-B-C, CHIN 169A-B, CHIN 182B-C, CHIN 185A-B-C.
nodes.description: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course that focuses on building familiarity with classical Chinese. Basic structures and function words are taught through fables of the pre-Qing period.

nodes.title: Classical Chinese II
nodes.prereq_text: any one of the following or department approval through placement interview: CHIN 165A-B-C, CHIN 169A-B, CHIN 182A, CHIN 182C, CHIN 185A-B-C.
nodes.description: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course that focuses on building familiarity with classical Chinese. Selections from Kongzi, Mengzi, and work of other philosophers will be taught. Focus is on structures, function words, and overall comprehension of a text.

nodes.title: Classical Chinese III
nodes.prereq_text: any one of the following or department approval through placement interview: CHIN 165A-B-C, CHIN 169A-B, CHIN 182A-B, CHIN 185A-B-C.
nodes.description: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course that focuses on building familiarity with classical Chinese. Selections from later periods like Shiji and poetry will be introduced. Focus is on structures, function words, and overall comprehension of a text.

nodes.description: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course that engages students on topics related to Chinese culture and society past and present through study of original texts and other media that expand reading and vocabulary skills on topics of interest.

nodes.title: Directed Thesis Research
Directed Group Study in Chinese Studies
nodes.prereq_text: consent of instructor.
nodes.description: Study of specific aspects in Chinese civilization not covered in regular course work, under the direction of faculty members in Chinese studies. (P/NP grades only.)

nodes.title: Independent Study in Chinese Studies
nodes.prereq_text: consent of instructor.
